s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Bearing

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press a new bearing into the bearing case.

s-1.ptxt: Install Drive Shaft Bearing Case Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Secure the bearing case in a vise between aluminum plates.
Using a screwdriver, install a new bearing case snap ring.
Using SST and a press, press the bearing case onto the inboard joint assembly RH.

atten3.ptxt: Do not apply force to the bearing case.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, install a new snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Dust Cover

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press in a new drive shaft dust cover to the position shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: Install the dust cover in the correct direction.
Do not press in the dust cover too far.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Dust Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press in a new drive shaft dust cover RH to the standard position.

atten3.ptxt: Install the dust cover in the correct direction.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Dust Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press in a new drive shaft dust cover LH.

atten3.ptxt: Install the dust cover in the correct direction.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Hole Snap Ring LH

s2.ptxt: Install a new hole snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Install Drive Shaft Outboard Joint Boot

s2.ptxt: Wrap protective tape around the splines of the outboard joint shaft assembly.
Install the following new parts to the outboard joint shaft assembly in this order.

s3.ptxt: Outboard joint boot clamp No.2 (A in illustration)
Outboard joint boot clamp (C in illustration)

s2.ptxt: Pack grease into the joint and boot of the outboard joint shaft assembly.
Install the outboard joint boot to the groove of the outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not allow grease to adhere to the groove.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp LH NO.2

s2.ptxt: Install the outboard joint boot clamp No.2 to the outboard joint boot.
Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, stake the outboard joint boot clamp No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp RH NO.2

atten4.ptxt: Install in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp LH

atten4.ptxt: Install in the same way as the outboard joint boot clamp No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp RH

atten4.ptxt: Install in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Damper LH

s2.ptxt: Install the drive shaft damper at the position shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Shaft Damper Clamp LH

s2.ptxt: For one-touch clamp type

s3.ptxt: Install a new damper clamp to the drive shaft damper.
Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, stake the damper clamp.

s2.ptxt: For hook type clamp

s3.ptxt: Install a new damper clamp to the drive shaft damper.
Using needle-nose pliers, hook the projection and recess of the damper clamp together to secure it.

item.ptxt: Do not deform the recessed and protruding portions.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Inboard Joint Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the following new parts to the outboard joint assembly in this order.

s3.ptxt: Inboard joint boot clamp (A in illustration)
Inboard joint boot clamp No.2 (C in illustration)

s2.ptxt: Secure the outboard joint shaft assembly in a vise between aluminum plates.
Align the matchmarks and install the tripod joint to the outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Install with the side that is serrated up to the joint end face facing outward.

s2.ptxt: Using a brass bar and hammer, tap in the tripod joint.

item.ptxt: Do not allow foreign matter to adhere to the tripod joint.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, install a new snap ring.
Pack grease into the inboard joint assembly LH.
Align the matchmarks and install the inboard joint assembly LH to the outboard joint shaft assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Drive Inboard Joint Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Install in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Boot

s2.ptxt: Install the inboard joint boot to the grooves of the inboard joint assembly and outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not allow grease to adhere to the fitting grooves of the boot.

atten4.ptxt: Install the inboard joint boot with dimension (A) as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp LH NO.2

s2.ptxt: For one-touch clamp type

s3.ptxt: Install the inboard joint boot clamp No.2 to the inboard joint boot.
Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, stake the inboard joint clamp No.2.

s2.ptxt: For hook type clamp

s3.ptxt: Install the inboard joint boot clamp No.2 to the inboard joint boot.
Using needle-nose pliers, hook the projection and recess of the inboard joint clamp No.2 together to secure it.

item.ptxt: Do not deform the projection and recess.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp RH NO.2

atten4.ptxt: Install in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp LH

s2.ptxt: For one-touch clamp type

s3.ptxt: Install the inboard joint boot clamp to the inboard joint boot.
Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, stake the inboard joint clamp.

s2.ptxt: For hook type clamp

s3.ptxt: Install the inboard joint boot clamp to the inboard joint boot.
Using needle-nose pliers, hook the projection and recess of the inboard joint clamp together to secure it.

item.ptxt: Do not deform the projection and recess.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp RH

atten4.ptxt: Install in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Drive Shaft Assembly

s2.ptxt: Check that the joints operate smoothly with no excessive play when moved up and down, left and right, and in the axial direction.
Check that the joint boots are free of cracks, damage and grease leakage.

atten3.ptxt: Carry the drive shaft assembly in a horizontal position.
